## 3. Core Software Systems & Repositories

### A. Saqib MD Bot (Multi-Device WhatsApp User Bot)
- **Primary Hub:** https://saqibmd.vercel.app/
- **Local Routing Gateway:** https://www.mrsaqib.me/bot
- **Protocol & Core Engine:** Node.js, Baileys WebSocket protocol for multi-device WhatsApp linking without keeping the phone connected.
- **Cluster Architecture:** 11-node load-balanced cluster (10 Heroku instances + 1 Railway backup) with automatic failover and sticky session affinity.
- **Key Features:** Automated command dispatch, media downloading (TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram), group moderation, anti-link deletion, and custom plugin support.

### B. Developer Tools OS (Suite of 20+ Utilities)
- **Primary URL:** https://www.mrsaqib.me/tools
- **Architecture:** Client-side sandboxed execution using Web Workers and modern browser APIs.
- **Features:** JavaScript obfuscation, AES-256 encryption/decryption, JSON schema validation, regex syntax testing, hash generators (SHA-256, MD5), and real-time calculation engines.
- **Privacy Standard:** Zero persistent telemetry on user-inputted source code or private keys.

### C. Crimson Ledger
- **Focus:** Specialized fintech receipt generation studio and invoice calculator.
- **Hosting & Code:** Production Next.js and Tailwind CSS with instant PDF rendering.

## 4. Production Technical Stack & Capabilities

### Frontend Engineering
- **Frameworks:** Next.js 15 (Pages and App Router), React 19.
- **Languages:** TypeScript (strict static typing), modern ES6+ JavaScript.
- **Styling & Animation:** Tailwind CSS v4, Motion / Framer Motion, responsive mobile-first architecture.
- **Core Web Vitals:** Sub-second LCP (Largest Contentful Paint), zero CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift), pre-rendered static generation.

### Backend, Database & Cloud
- **Runtimes:** Node.js (V8), Express.js.
- **Databases:** Supabase (PostgreSQL with strict Row Level Security policies), MongoDB, Redis caching.
- **APIs:** RESTful endpoints, Server-Sent Events (SSE), WebSockets.
- **Deployment:** Vercel Fluid Compute, Cloudflare DNS, Docker containerization.

### Security Architecture
- **Controls:** Zero-Trust network boundary, PBKDF2 with SHA-256 password hashing, CSRF token validation, XSS escaping, strict CSP (Content Security Policy) headers.
- **Admin Gateway:** Mirage multi-layer lock screen with dynamic session token rotation.
